questions.question: What is the difference between the chat and the Code tab?

options.text: Claude on the Code tab can do things on your computer, the chat only answers
options.explanation: Correct. Claude Code creates and edits files in your project folder when you give it permission.

options.text: Nothing, they are the same thing with a different name
options.explanation: They are in the same app, but they work differently. The chat writes answers, Claude Code makes changes to files.

options.text: The Code tab just answers faster
options.explanation: The difference isn’t speed. Claude Code works on your files, the chat only answers.

questions.question: Which folder does Claude Code work in?

options.text: The folder you choose for it
options.explanation: Exactly. That’s why every project gets its own folder.

options.text: Always on the desktop, because it’s a desktop app
options.explanation: The name refers to the app being installed on your computer. You choose the folder yourself.

options.text: Any folder it comes up with itself
options.explanation: You choose the folder when you start working on the Code tab.

questions.question: Who decides how freely Claude may make changes?

options.explanation: Correct. The mode determines whether Claude asks permission before a change or you review the changes afterwards.
Claude acts according to the mode you choose. The decision is yours.

options.text: Nobody, Claude always does everything without asking
options.explanation: Not true. You can choose a mode where Claude asks permission before every change.
